usage: Tea 茶 is commonly used as a noun referring to the drink made by infusing dried tea leaves in hot water.
In Cantonese, 茶 can appear as a standalone noun or combined with other words to specify types of tea or tea-drinking activities.
When ordering dim sum, it is customary to start with having a pot or cup of 茶 as a staple beverage.
茶 can sometimes be used in expressions related to breaks or social gatherings centered around drinking tea.
The word 茶 remains unchanged regardless of quantity; the context or measure words indicate how much tea is being referred to.
